name: Lego Mindstorms EV3
def: Programmable robotics kit from the Lego Group, the third generation of the Mindstorms line, announced at CES in January 2013 and succeeding the NXT.
facts: Announced on 4 January 2013 at CES in Las Vegas
Reached shops on 1 September 2013; education edition on 1 August 2013
Used in contests such as FIRST LEGO League Challenge and World Robot Olympiad
LEGO retired the Mindstorms line at the end of 2022
